entities.summary: Gyodong In clan was one of the Korean clans. Their Bon-gwan is in Ganghwa County, Incheon. According to the research in 2015, the number of Gyodong In clan was 20,737 people. Their founder was In Seo who was an Adjunct in Jin dynasty, China. He was dispatched to Silla as an embassy. After that, he was naturalized to Silla.
